## Signature check (SECURITY.md rule 3)
Convex signs `t.payload` with HMAC-SHA256. n8n recomputes it with the **LendLoop webhook secret** credential, compares in constant time, and rejects anything older than 5 minutes. The payload arrives as a string so the exact signed bytes are verified.

## Send once per event (rule 5)
Convex retries with backoff, so the same eventId can arrive twice. The Data Table remembers sent ids. Gmail retries 3 times; if it still fails the run errors, Convex gets a 500, retries later, and the error workflow reports it.
